## Brine Dragon, Mature Adult (CR 12)

**XP** 19,200  
 LN Large dragon (water)  
 **Init** +4; **Senses** dragon senses; Perception +22; **Aura** frightful presence (210 ft., DC 21)  

**Defense**

 **AC** 30, touch 9, flat-footed 30 (+21 natural, -1 size)  
 **hp** 168 (16d12+64)  
 **Fort** +14, **Ref** +12, **Will** +13  
 **DR** 10/magic; **Immune** acid, paralysis, sleep; **SR** 23  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 60 ft., fly 200 ft. (poor), swim 60 ft.  
 **Melee** bite +26 (2d6+16), 2 claws +26 (1d8+11), tail slap +21 (1d8+16), 2 wings +21 (1d6+5)  
 **Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft. (10 ft. with bite)  
 **Special Attacks** breath weapon (80-ft. line, 14d6 acid, DC 22)  
 **Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 16th; concentration +19)  

 At will—*[control water](../../magic/spells/control-water.md)*, *[obscuring mist](../../magic/spells/obscuring-mist.md)*, *[speak with animals](../../magic/spells/speak-with-animals.md)* (fish only), *[water breathing](../../magic/spells/water-breathing.md)*

 **Spells Known** (CL 9th; concentration +12)  

 4th (4/day)—*[ice storm](../../magic/spells/ice-storm.md)*, *[greater invisibility](../../magic/spells/invisibility-greater.md)*  
 3rd (7/day)—*[aqueous orb](../../magic/spells/aqueous-orb.md)** (DC 16), *[deep slumber](../../magic/spells/deep-slumber.md)* (DC 16), *[sleet storm](../../magic/spells/sleet-storm.md)* (DC 16)  
 2nd (7/day)—*[alter self](../../magic/spells/alter-self.md)*, *[detect thoughts](../../magic/spells/detect-thoughts.md)*, *[invisibility](../../magic/spells/invisibility.md)*, *[slipstream](../../magic/spells/slipstream.md)**  
 1st (7/day)—*[color spray](../../magic/spells/color-spray.md)* (DC 14), *[feather fall](../../magic/spells/feather-fall.md)*, *[flare burst](../../magic/spells/flare-burst.md)** (DC 14), *[ray of enfeeblement](../../magic/spells/ray-of-enfeeblement.md)*, *[touch of the sea](../../magic/spells/touch-of-the-sea.md)**  
 0 (at will)—*[detect magic](../../magic/spells/detect-magic.md)*, *[detect poison](../../magic/spells/detect-poison.md)*, *[mage hand](../../magic/spells/mage-hand.md)*, *[message](../../magic/spells/message.md)*, *[open/close](../../magic/spells/open-close.md)*, *[prestidigitation](../../magic/spells/prestidigitation.md)*, *[read magic](../../magic/spells/read-magic.md)*, *[resistance](../../magic/spells/resistance.md)*  

 ** – denotes spell from Advanced Player’s Guide.*

**Statistics**

 **Str** 32, **Dex** 11, **Con** 19, **Int** 19, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 17  
 **Base Atk** +16; **CMB** +28 (+30 bull rush); **CMD** 38 (40 vs. bull rush, 42 vs. trip)  
 **Feats** Hover, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Initiative, Improved Vital Strike, Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack, Skill Focus (Swim), Vital Strike  
 **Skills** Bluff +22, Diplomacy +22, Fly +13, Heal +22, Knowledge (arcana, nature) +23, Perception +22, Sense Motive +22, Survival +22, Swim +44; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Swim  
 **Languages** Aquan, Common, Draconic, Elven, Halfling  
 **SQ** water breathing

  

**Ecology**

**Environment** any aquatic (Plane of Water)  
 **Organization** solitary  
 **Treasure** triple
